then.say: Spare a coin for an old ringer? No? Spare a minute, then. Those are cheaper. Hobb.
Forty years I pulled the great bell. Then the bell started ringing without me. I took the hint.

do.say: It calls them in at dusk. Pilgrims, monks, rats. Everything with a wick in it walks toward that sound.
Stuff your ears with wax if you go up. Ha. Wax. There's plenty.
Best seat on the hill. Everyone goes in past me. I like to know who.
Go on, then. I'll count you on the way out. If.
